Countertop replacement is not included. Includes disposal of old cabinets but no painting or trim work. Based on the continuous length of cabinets as measured along the floor.

title: Kitchen Garbage Disposal Replacement
description: Remove and replace 1/2hp garbage disposal (or disposer). Assumes no electrical or plumbing work beyond basic disconnect and reconnect. Includes appliance cost. Higher end disposals cost more depending on brand, decibel, and horsepower rating.

title: Major Kitchen Remodel, Premium
description: Gut existing kitchen down to the studs and subfloor then replace with designer cabinets, including an island and premium quartz countertops. Install an undermount 3 bowl enameled cast iron sink with a premium faucet. Include commercial grade appliance package including a built-in refrigerator, double electric wall ovens, gas cooktop, microwave, and range hood. Add imported ceramic tile backsplash illuminated with undercabinet task lighting. Light the space with recessed lights and designer hanging fixtures above the island. Replace windows in existing opening. Install granite tile flooring and finish with painted walls, trim and ceiling. High-end level of finish overall.

title: Garage, Single Car
description: Build a new single-car garage on 4inpoured concrete slab. Includes steel garage door with opener, double hung aluminum windows, and steel exterior door. Enclose with vinyl siding and soffits/fascia, aluminum gutters & downspouts, and 25yr fiberglass shingles over gable roof. No electrical included. Demolition of an existing garage will add to the costs.

title: Garage, Two Car
description: Build a new two-car garage on 4in poured concrete slab. Includes 2 steel garage doors with openers, double hung aluminum windows, and steel exterior door. Enclose with vinyl siding and soffits/fascia, aluminum gutters & downspouts, and 25yr fiberglass shingles over gable roof. No electrical included. Demolition of an existing garage will add to the costs.

title: Ceiling Repair - Hole in Drywall
description: Patch hole in drywall ceiling up to 8in in diameter. If this task is part of a larger painting project then the costs will be lower. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Wall Repair - Replace Damaged Section of Drywall
description: Replace area of drywall wall up to 32 sq feet, taped, finished, and painted. If this task is part of a larger painting project then the costs will be lower. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Paint Garage Floor
description: Prepare surface then paint garage floor with non-slip aluminum oxide paint. Assumes there are no cracks to be repaired and that the area is cleared of all contents.

title: Wall Repair - Hole in Drywall
description: Patch hole in drywall wall up to 8in in diameter. If this task is part of a larger painting project then the costs will be lower. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Remove Popcorn Texture from Ceiling
description: Remove popcorn texture from ceiling then repaint with roller, 2 coats. Assumes no asbestos is present and ceiling height is less than 10ft.

title: Ceiling Repair - Replace Damaged Section of Drywall
description: Replace area of drywall ceiling up to 32 sq feet, taped, finished, and painted. If this task is part of a larger painting project then the costs will be lower. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Painting, Exterior 1 Story, Complete Sided House
description: Paint the entire exterior of a 1 story house. Sand & fill exterior doors, windows, and trim. Brush on 2 coats for wood siding including soffits, fascia, windows, trim, and exterior doors. Based on the FLOOR AREA square footage of the home (not total painted area).

title: Ceiling Repair - Replace Damaged Section of Plaster
description: Replace area of plaster ceiling up to 32 sq feet, taped, finished, and painted. If this task is part of a larger painting project then the costs will be lower. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Wall Repair - Hole in Plaster
description: Patch hole in plaster wall up to 8in in diameter. If this task is part of a larger painting project then the costs will be lower. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Painting, Exterior 2 Story, Complete Sided House
description: Paint the entire exterior of a 2 story house. Sand & fill exterior doors, windows, and trim. Brush on 2 coats for wood siding including soffits, fascia, windows, trim, and exterior doors. Based on the TOTAL FLOOR AREA square footage, including both floors, of the home (not total painted area).

title: Ceiling Repair - Hole in Plaster
description: Patch hole in plaster ceiling up to 8in in diameter. If this task is part of a larger painting project then the costs will be lower. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Wall Repair - Replace Damaged Area of Plaster Wall
description: Replace area of plaster wall up to 32 sq feet, taped, finished, and painted. If this task is part of a larger painting project then the costs will be lower. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Painting, Exterior 2 Story House, Trim Only
description: Paint the exterior trim of a 2 story house. Sand & fill exterior doors, windows, and trim. Brush on 2 coats including soffits, fascia, windows, trim, and exterior doors. Based on the TOTAL FLOOR AREA square footage, including both floors, of the home (not total painted area).

title: Painting, Exterior 1 Story House, Trim Only
description: Paint the exterior trim of a 1 story house. Sand & fill exterior doors, windows, and trim. Brush on 2 coats including soffits, fascia, windows, trim, and exterior doors. Based on the FLOOR AREA square footage of the home (not total painted area).

title: Painting, Interior
description: Paint the interior of the home. Mask the floor with plastic sheeting then paint all ceilings and walls with roller, 2 coats. Paint interior trim, doors, and window trims/frames. Based on the FLOOR SQUARE FOOTAGE of the area of the home being painted (not total painted area).

title: Basement Remodel - Suspended Grid Ceiling
description: Convert an unfinished basement into a nice fully finished space. Frame 2x4in walls against foundation with full insulation and vapor barriers. Cover ceiling with 24x24in suspended grid ceiling system and walls with drywall. Includes interior doors with hardware. Install new baseboard electric heat and electrical components including outlets, switches, and lighting fixtures. Install new premium vinyl sheet flooring. Paint walls and trim. Assumes a staircase to the space is already present. Re-routing any ductwork or plumbing will add costs, as will relocation of any of the mechanicals. If the space is to be converted to a bedroom an egress window and closet will also need to be added.

title: Basement Remodel - Drywall Ceiling
description: Convert an unfinished basement into a nice fully finished space. Frame 2x4 walls against foundation with full insulation and vapor barriers. Cover walls and ceiling with drywall. Includes interior doors with hardware. Install new baseboard electric heat and electrical components including outlets, switches, and lighting fixtures. Install new premium vinyl sheet flooring. Paint walls and trim. Assumes a staircase to the space is already present. Re-routing any ductwork or plumbing will add costs, as will relocation of any of the mechanicals. If the space is to be converted to a bedroom an egress window and closet will also need to be added.

title: Roofing Repair - Sheathing Repair
description: Remove and replace damaged plywood or OSB roof sheathing/decking on a small area of roof, 10-15 sq feet, and cover with new fiberglass shingles. Additional costs will apply if the pitch of the roof is steep, rot is discovered in the rafters, or the area is difficult to reach by ladder. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required from the roofer.

title: Roofing Replacement - Spanish (Clay) Tile
description: Demolish existing clay/Spanish tile roof and replace with new, 11in on center, 15in exposure. Flash chimney, plumbing vents, and valleys with aluminum. Additional features like dormers and skylights will add to the cost. Based on the square footage of the home's footprint.

title: Roofing Replacement - Slate
description: Demolish existing slate roof and replace with new, average quality. Flash chimney, plumbing vents, and valleys with aluminum. Additional features like dormers and skylights will add to the cost. Based on the square footage of the home's footprint.

title: Roof Ridge Vent Replacement
description: Install continuous ridge vent, shingle over style, by cutting into roof and installing. Based on the length of the roof ridge being vented.

title: Roofing Repair - Cedar Shingles
description: Remove and replace cedar shingles. Each "piece" of repair includes up to 9 sq feet of affected cedar shingles. Additional costs will apply if the pitch of the roof is steep or the area is difficult to reach by ladder. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required from the roofer.

title: Clean Gutters - 1st Story
description: Clean gutters on the 1st story of a home, by ladder. Costs might be higher if there is an excessive amount of build-up. Based on the length of the gutters being cleaned on the 1st story of the home.

title: Roofing Repair - Slate Shingles
description: Remove and replace slate shingles. Each "piece" of repair includes up to 9 sq feet of affected slate shingles. Additional costs will apply if the pitch of the roof is steep or the area is difficult to reach by ladder. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required from the roofer.

title: Gutter Replacement
description: Remove existing gutters and replace with 5 inch seamless aluminum guttering, no downspouts included. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story or if gutter guards are included.

title: Roofing Replacement  - Dimensional
description: Demolish existing layer of roofing and replace with architectural/laminate/dimensional 240lb, 30 year fiberglass shingles. Flash chimney, plumbing vents, and valleys with aluminum. Continuous ridge vent. Additional features like dormers and skylights will add to the cost. Based on the square footage of the home's footprint.

title: Roofing Replacement - Rubber Membrane
description: Demolish existing membrane roof and replace with new. Flash chimney, plumbing vents. Additional features like dormers and skylights will add to the cost. Based on the square footage of the home's footprint.

title: Replace Damaged Roof Vent
description: Remove and replace a damaged, passive (non electric), roof vent with a new one to improve air circulation in attic. Assumes a standard metal rectangular louver vent (15 x 21in), and includes caulking for a watertight seal. Costs might be higher if the roof pitch is steep.

title: Replace Flashing on Roof
description: Replace rusted, damaged, or missing stepflashing on roof. Includes nails and sealant. Costs might be higher if the roof is steep or cutting of siding materials is required. Based on the linear feet of the flashing being replaced.

title: Roofing Replacement  - Traditional 3 Tab
description: Demolish existing layer of roofing and replace with traditional 3 tab 240lb, 30 year fiberglass shingles. Flash chimney, plumbing vents, and valleys with aluminum. Continuous ridge vent. Additional features like dormers and skylights will add to the cost. Based on the square footage of the home's footprint.

title: Roofing Repair - Spanish (Clay) Tile
description: Remove and replace Spanish (clay) tiles. Each "piece" of repair includes up to 9 sq feet of affected shingles. Additional costs will apply if the pitch of the roof is steep or the area is difficult to reach by ladder. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required from the roofer.

title: Roofing Repair - Fiberglass Shingles
description: Remove and replace fiberglass/asphalt shingles. Each "piece" of repair includes up to 9 sq feet of affected shingles. Additional costs will apply if the pitch of the roof is steep or the area is difficult to reach by ladder. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required from the roofer.

title: Downspout Replacement
description: Remove damaged downspout and replace with 3 x 4 inch aluminum downspout, including elbow and extension to direct water away from home. Based on the height of the section that is being replaced. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Extend Downspouts Away from Foundation
description: Extend downspout 6ft away from the foundation which, along with proper grading, can prevent water ingress issues in the basement. Uses 3 x 4in aluminum downspouts and includes the elbow connector but does not include painting. Material costs will be higher if galvanized steel or copper is used instead of aluminum. Based on the number of downspouts that need to be extended, not the distance they are to be extended.

title: Clean Gutters - 2nd Story
description: Clean gutters on the 2nd story of a home, by ladder. Costs might be higher if there is an excessive amount of build-up. Based on the length of the gutters being cleaned on the 2nd story of the home.

title: Driveway Replacement - Brick
description: Demolish all/portion of current brick driveway and replace with new atop a sand base. No apron work included.

title: Fence Replacement - 6ft Cedar Solid Board
description: Remove perimeter fence and replace with new 1x6in, 6ft high solid board cedar fence. Includes disposal of old fence.

title: Walkway Replacement - Concrete
description: Demolish all/portion of current concrete walkway and replace with new (non reinforced) using forms and a poured 3in slab. A thicker slab will cost more. Includes disposal of removed walkway section.

title: Driveway/Walkway Repair - Concrete
description: Apply concrete crack sealer on horizontal surface with epoxy patch product. Cracks wider than 1/2in or cracks that result in an uneven surface will cost more or might not be patchable. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required. Based on the length of the crack.

title: Driveway Replacement - Concrete
description: Demolish all/portion of current concrete driveway and replace with new 4in thick slab, reinforced with wire mesh. No apron work included.

title: Driveway Replacement - Asphalt
description: Demolish all/portion of current asphalt driveway and replace with new. Includes minimum 6in of aggregate base and 3in of asphalt. No apron work included. Costs will be higher for a thicker driveway.

title: Fence Replacement - 4ft Cedar Pickets
description: Remove perimeter fence and replace with new cedar picket fence, 4ft high. Includes disposal of old fence.

title: Brush Removal
description: Cut up to 300 sq feet of brush up to 18in tall with machine.

title: Driveway/Walkway Repair - Asphalt
description: Apply asphalt crack filler/sealer from tubed patching product. Cracks wider than 3/4in or cracks that result in an uneven surface will cost more or might not be patchable. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required. Based on the length of the crack.

title: Walkway Replacement - Brick
description: Demolish all/portion of current brick walkway and replace with new. Includes disposal of removed walkway section.

title: Stump Removal
description: Grind stump (8 - 12in diameter) below surface and other large surface roots. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Fence Replacement - 6ft Pressure Treated Solid Board
description: Remove perimeter fence and replace with new 1x6in, 6ft high solid board pressure treated fence. Includes disposal of old fence.

title: Sod Installation, No Topsoil Work
description: Supply and lay sod. Deep water one time. Assumes minimal site preparation and no need for excavation equipment. Placement of soil or fertilizer will increase the cost.

title: Retaining Wall Replacement - Pressure Treated
description: Remove existing retaining wall, re-excavate earth as necessary by hand, then replace with retaining wall constructed from 6x8in pressure treated lumber. Based on the vertical square footage of the wall being replaced. For example, a 10ft section of wall that is 4ft high would be 40 sq feet.

title: Tree Removal
description: Tree and stump removal. Costs will be higher if access to the tree is obstructed. Based on the height of the tree.

title: Walkway Replacement - Asphalt
description: Demolish all/portion of current asphalt walkway and replace with new. Includes minimum 6in of stone base and 3in of asphalt. Includes disposal of removed walkway section.

title: Retaining Wall Replacement - Stacked Fieldstone
description: Remove existing retaining wall, re-excavate earth as necessary by hand, then replace with retaining wall constructed from dry stacked fieldstone. Includes 18in base and 12in top. Based on the vertical square footage of the wall being replaced. For example, a 10ft section of wall that is 3ft high would be 30 sq feet. Assumes no new footing is required and old materials are discarded rather than re-used.

title: Patio Replacement - Stone
description: Demolish all/portion of current stone patio and replace with new flagstone atop a sand base. Includes disposal of old patio.

title: Regrade and Compact Soil
description: Re-grade and mechanically compact soil near the perimeter of the home to allow proper drainage of water away from the foundation. This will help prevent water ingress issues and the potential for structural damage from frost heaving. The process includes manual excavation and placement of topsoil, compaction by vibrating plate, and the spread of grass seed on the disturbed area.

title: Fence Replacement - 4ft Chain Link Fence
description: Remove perimeter fence and replace with new 9 gauge chain link fence, 4ft high, with 10ft post spacing. Includes one gate and disposal of old fence. Costs might be higher for sloped yards or if there are multiple gates.

title: Sod Installation, With Topsoil Work
description: Place topsoil and grade by hand at 6 - 12in deep then compact with vibrating plate. Place sod, roll & water.

title: Fence Replacement - 6ft Chain Link Fence
description: Remove perimeter fence and replace with new 9 gauge chain link fence, 6ft high, with 10ft post spacing. Includes one gate and disposal of old fence. Costs might be higher for sloped yards or if there are multiple gates.

title: Patio Replacement - Brick
description: Demolish all/portion of current brick patio and replace with new atop a sand base. Includes disposal of old patio.

title: Siding Replacement - Natural Stone Veneer
description: Remove and replace stone siding/veneer with new natural stone veneer. Removal of heavy construction debris included. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story or if replacement stone is difficult to source. Costs are for replacing portions of a home's facade, not an entire home where discounts would apply. Based on the square footage of the stone veneer being replaced.

title: Trim Replacement - Cedar
description: Remove exterior trim piece and replace with cedar up to 6in wide, brush on primer and 2 coats with water based paint. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story.

title: Brick Tuck Pointing - Heavy (25-40%) Damage
description: Clean joints & repoint brick wall on 25 - 40% of joints. Additional costs will apply to work done above the first story. Based on sq footage of wall area containing the damage.

title: Caulking Replacement
description: General re-caulking task on the exterior of home, such as for waterproofing windows/doors/etc. Includes removal of old caulk as necessary. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Siding Repair - Brick
description: Remove and replace damaged brick area, up to 5 connected bricks. Costs will be higher if a direct replacement is difficult to source. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required. Based on the number of individual spots that need work.

title: Siding Replacement - Wood
description: Remove and replace wood siding with new 6in pine/fir lap siding, smooth. Paint with water based paint, 2 coats rolled. Disposal of old siding is included. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story or if replacement siding is difficult to source. Based on the square footage of the siding being replaced.

title: Brick Tuck Pointing - Light (less than 10%) Damage
description: Clean joints & repoint brick wall on less than 10% of joints. Additional costs will apply to work done above the first story. Based on sq footage of wall area containing the damage.

title: Siding Replacement - Vinyl
description: Remove and replace vinyl siding with new 8in double 4, including necessary trim. Disposal of old siding is included. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story or if replacement siding is difficult to source. Based on the square footage of the siding being replaced.

title: Chimney Flashing Replacement
description: Remove failing chimney flashing and replace with new aluminum flashing for approximately 32x36in chimney. Larger chimneys or stone chimneys will be more expensive. Complex geometries and steep roof pitches can also add to the cost. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Siding Repair - Aluminum
description: Remove and replace damaged pieces of aluminum siding. No painting included. Costs will be higher if a direct replacement is difficult to source. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required. Based on the number of pieces of siding affected.

title: Siding Repair - Cedar Shingle
description: Remove and replace small section of cedar shingle siding, up to 9 sq feet, and apply stain. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required. Based on the number of individual sections that need work.

title: Siding Replacement - Cedar Shingle
description: Remove and replace cedar shingle/shake siding with new 16in shingles with 5in exposure. Stain with oil-based paint, brush, 2 coats. Disposal of old siding is included. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story. Based on the square footage of the siding being replaced.

title: Siding Repair - Vinyl
description: Remove and replace damaged vinyl siding. Costs will be higher if a direct replacement is difficult to source. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required. Based on the number of pieces of siding affected.

title: Siding Replacement - Board and Batten
description: Remove and replace board and batten siding with new 1x10in cedar board and batten siding. Stain with oil-based paint, spray, 1 coats. Disposal of old siding is included. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story. Based on the square footage of the siding being replaced.

title: Siding Replacement - Fiber Cement
description: Remove and replace siding with new fiber-cement lap siding, smooth. No painting included. Disposal of old siding is included. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story or if replacement siding is difficult to source. Based on the square footage of the siding being replaced.

title: Siding Replacement - Aluminum
description: Remove and replace aluminum siding with new 8in double 4, including necessary trim. No painting included. Disposal of old siding is included. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story or if replacement siding is difficult to source. Based on the square footage of the siding being replaced.

title: Trim Replacement - Aluminum
description: Remove exterior trim piece and replace with aluminum trim up to 6in wide, brush on 2 coats with water based paint. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story.

title: Siding Replacement - Stucco
description: Remove and replace stucco with new. Removal of heavy construction debris included. Disposal of old siding is included. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story or if there is a complicated texture to match. If the structural integrity of the stucco is intact, resurfacing could be done as a less expensive alternative. Based on the square footage of the siding being replaced.

title: Siding Repair - Wood Siding
description: Remove and replace damaged wood siding. Match paint and brush on 2 coats. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required. Based on the number of pieces of siding affected.

title: Soffit Replacement - Wood
description: Remove existing damaged wood soffit and replace with new fir/pine. Brush paint 2 coats, water-based paint. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story. If the soffits are larger than 12in costs will be also higher. Assumes there is no rot present in the rafters or frieze board.

title: Trim Replacement - PVC
description: Remove exterior trim piece and replace with cellular PVC trim up to 6in wide, brush on primer and 2 coats with water based paint. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story.

title: Gable Vent Installation
description: Install 16in vinyl louver vent on gable for ventilation. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Fascia Replacement - Wood
description: Remove existing damaged wood fascia and replace with new fir/pine. Brush paint 2 coats, water-based paint. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story. Assumes there is no rot present in the rafters.

title: Stucco Repair
description: Repair hole in stucco up to 10in and paint to match existing stucco. Costs will be more if the work is above the first story or difficult to access. Assumes no rotting in wall sheathing.

title: Siding Replacement - Manufactured Stone Veneer
description: Remove and replace stone siding/veneer with new manufactured stone veneer. Removal of heavy construction debris included. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story or if replacement material is difficult to source. Costs are for replacing portions of a home's facade, not an entire home where discounts would apply. Based on the square footage of the stone veneer being replaced.

title: Brick Tuck Pointing - Medium (25-40%) Damage
description: Clean joints & repoint brick wall on 10 - 25% of joints. Additional costs will apply to work done above the first story. Based on sq footage of wall area containing the damage.

title: Soffit & Fascia Replacement - Aluminum
description: Remove damaged aluminum soffit & fascia, replace with new. Costs will be higher for work done above the first story. If the soffits are larger than 12in costs will also be higher. Assumes there is no rot present in the rafters or frieze board.

title: Skylight Replacement - Manual Ventilating
description: Remove existing skylight & curb, build new curb and install manually ventilating skylight approximately 30x46in in size (tempered Low-E glass). No blinds included.

title: Skylight Replacement - Electric Ventilating
description: Remove existing skylight & curb, build new curb and install electric ventilating skylight approximately 34x50in in size (tempered Low-E glass). No blinds included.

title: Door Replacement - Interior Three Panel Closet Door
description: Remove existing doors and replace with new 3-panel closet door, 8ft wide total. Includes painting and hardware.

title: Repair Broken Glass on Window
description: Install new single pane and reglaze glass up to 4 sq feet. Costs will be higher for double pane glass.

title: Skylight Replacement - Tubular
description: Remove and replace tubular skylight (or sun tube), approximately 14in diameter.

title: Door Replacement - Exterior Atrium Door
description: Remove existing door and replace with new pre-hung 6ft wide atrium door including average quality knob/lockset. An atrium door resembles a French door but only one side is operable. Assumes the door is clad so no painting is required.

title: Door Replacement - Storm Door
description: Replace storm door with new aluminum frame door, half view with screen insert. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Window Replacement - Large Vinyl
description: Replace large size (approx. 4x5ft) window with new insulated glass, average quality vinyl window in the same window opening. Discounts might apply for high volume jobs, such as replacements for an entire home.

title: Window Replacement - Medium Vinyl
description: Replace medium size (approx. 3x4ft) window with new insulated glass, average quality vinyl window in the same window opening. Discounts might apply for high volume jobs, such as replacements for an entire home.

title: Garage Door Replacement - Two Car
description: Remove garage door and replace with new 16x7ft steel garage door, including hardware.

title: Door Knob Set Replacement - Interior
description: Replace interior door knob set with new average grade passage set (non locking). Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Door Weatherstripping
description: Install weatherstripping around exterior door and new door sweep. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Garage Door Opener Replacement
description: Install new 1/3hp garage door opener, chain drive. Costs will be higher if a motor support bracket is not already present.

title: Garage Door Replacement - One Car
description: Remove garage door and replace with new 9x7ft steel garage door, including hardware.

title: Door Replacement - Screen Door
description: Replace screen door with new half screen door, wood frame (no glass). Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Door Trim Replacement
description: Remove, replace and paint casing around door. This does not include the door jamb. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Window Replacement - Small Wood Clad
description: Replace small size (approx. 2x3ft) wood window with new insulated glass, average quality wood window clad with aluminum/vinyl in the same window opening. Discounts might apply for high volume jobs, such as replacements for an entire home.

title: Door Replacement - Interior Panel Door, Painted
description: Remove existing door and replace with new oak panel door. Paint both sides of door, jamb and casing. Includes average quality passage set knob hardware.

title: Door Replacement - Interior Two Panel Closet Door
description: Remove existing doors and replace with new 2-panel closet door, 6ft wide total. Includes painting and hardware.

title: Door Lock Set Replacement - Exterior
description: Replace exterior door handle and lock with new, quality lockset. Advanced features like smart locks or security cameras will cost more. Additional trip fees might apply if this is the only task required.

title: Door Replacement - Interior Flush Door, Painted
description: Remove existing door and replace with new flush hollow core door. Paint both sides of door, jamb and casing. Includes average quality passage set knob hardware.

title: Window Replacement - Small Vinyl
description: Replace small size (approx. 2x3ft) window with new insulated glass, average quality vinyl window in the same window opening. Discounts might apply for high volume jobs, such as replacements for an entire home.

title: Window Replacement - Medium Wood Clad
description: Replace medium size (approx. 3x4ft) wood window with new insulated glass, average quality wood window clad with aluminum/vinyl in the same window opening. Discounts might apply for high volume jobs, such as replacements for an entire home.

title: Door Replacement - Exterior Steel with Half Window
description: Remove existing steel door and replace with new pre-hung 36in steel exterior door with half window. Paint the door, jamb, & trim with brush (2 coats, both sides), water-based paint. Includes average quality knob/lockset.

title: Door Replacement - Exterior Sliding Patio
description: Remove existing sliding patio door and replace with new 6ft aluminum sliding glass door with insulated glass. Paint the door and trim with brush (2 coats, both sides), water-based paint. Includes average grade lockset.

title: Skylight Replacement - Fixed
description: Remove existing skylight & curb, build new curb and install fixed skylight approximately 30x46in in size (tempered Low-E glass). No blinds included.

title: Window Replacement - Large Wood Clad
description: Replace large size (approx. 4x5ft) wood window with new insulated glass, average quality wood window clad with aluminum/vinyl in the same window opening. Discounts might apply for high volume jobs, such as replacements for an entire home.

title: Flooring Replacement - Average Vinyl Plank
description: Remove old flooring and install new vinyl plank flooring at up to $3.00 per sq foot cost. Assumes existing base molding can be preserved.

title: Flooring Replacement - Economy Sheet Vinyl
description: Remove old flooring and install new sheet vinyl flooring at up to $1.50 per sq foot budget. Assumes existing base molding can be preserved.

title: Flooring Replacement - Economy Stone Tile
description: Remove old tile and install stone tile flooring at up to $6.00 per sq foot budget. Set mortar with grout & seal. Costs will be higher for tight spaces or areas with complex geometries that require extra cuts.

title: Flooring Replacement - Ceramic Tile, $8/SF Tile Budget
description: Demolish existing ceramic tile and replace with new tile at $8 per sq foot budget over cement board underlayment. Set mortar with grout & seal. Costs will be higher for tight spaces or areas with complex geometries that require extra cuts.

title: Flooring Replacement - Average Sheet Vinyl
